title: Glutamate Measurement Protocol
author: Karen Maciel de Oliveira
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rufd6tn
materials: NICHOLLS DG, SIHRA TS, SANCHEZ -PIETRO J. Cal cium dependent and independent release of glutamate from synaptosomes monitored by continuous fluorometry. J Neurochem. 1987; 49:50 -57. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1471-4159.1987.tb03393.x. ROMANO-SILVA MA, RIBEIRO-SANTOS R, RIBEIRO AM, GOMEZ MV, DINIZ CR, CORDEIRO MN, BRAMMER MJ. Rat cortical synaptosomes have more than one mechanism for Ca2+ entry linked to rapid glutamate release: studies using the Phoneutria nigriventer toxin PhTx 2 and potassium depolarization. Biochem. 1993; 296:313-319. https://doi.org/10.1042/bj2960313.

steps.title: Flex rat head for access
steps.instruction: Immediately after euthanasia, flex the rat head downward about 45° to expose a palpable rhomb‑shaped depressible surface between the occipital protuberances and the atlas spine.

steps.title: Collect CSF from cisterna magna
steps.instruction: Insert a 22G needle into the cisterna magna, connect it to a 1 mL syringe, aspirate 50–80 µL of uncontaminated cerebrospinal fluid, and store the sample at –80 °C.

steps.title: Add cofactors and record baseline
steps.instruction: Transfer the CSF to the fluorimeter cuvette, record fluorescence (excitation 360 nm, emission 450 nm), then immediately add NADP⁺ to a final concentration of 1.0 mM followed by CaCl₂ to a final concentration of 1.0 mM.

substeps.instruction: Record baseline fluorescence (360 nm excitation, 450 nm emission)

steps.title: Add GDH and monitor fluorescence
steps.instruction: After a 70 s incubation, add glutamate dehydrogenase (50 units) and monitor NADPH fluorescence until a constant equilibrium value is reached; this equilibrium reflects glutamate present in the 5 µL sample.

steps.title: Calibrate with standard glutamate
steps.instruction: Following an additional 500 s, add standard glutamate to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM and record the maximal fluorescence response for calibration.

substeps.instruction: Add standard glutamate to 1 mM final

steps.title: Calculate glutamate concentration
steps.instruction: Express the result as nmol µL⁻¹ of CSF based on the maximal response obtained after the 1 mM glutamate addition.
